entities.summary: Gabriel Ifeanyi "Iffe" Lundberg is a Danish professional basketball player for Maccabi Tel Aviv of the Israeli Ligat HaAl and the EuroLeague. He also represents the Denmark national team. Standing at 1.93 m, he can play at both guard positions. According to numerous Danish outlets, Lundberg is Denmark's best basketball player.
